headline: Barcelona's Kabilio has raised €10 million for AI accounting
body: Kabilio, a Barcelona-based AI platform for accounting firms and the small businesses they serve, has raised €10 million in a funding round led by Picus Capital and Visionaries.
note: The round is a data point for AI in back-office finance work, where accounting firms and their small business clients sit.
